ModMetaData.name: Recoverable Throwables 1.5 v1.2
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: Physical thrown weapons such as javelins, throwing axes and throwing knives become finite, recoverable equipment. V1.2 hooks Projectile.Launch directly, consumes one real weapon per launched projectile, and restores that exact item when the projectile ends. It supports thrown weapons that do not use Combat_RangedFire_Thrown, including VFE Medieval 2's throwing axe. Explosive grenade-style throwables remain the responsibility of Grenade One-Use. Configure these physical thrown weapons as no-ammo weapons in LTS Ammunition.
